design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine vintage bus architecture visuals with luxury editorial typography and warm candlelit night photography.
Emotion First: Evoke warmth, romantic intimacy, starlit enchantment, and gourmet comfort in every section.
Content as Cinema: Treat every section as a numbered manifesto chapter with deliberate line-by-line reveals, ambient lighting effects, and warm golden glows.
Negative Space & Contrast: Soft cream background contrasts against deep warm espresso dark zones and rich gold highlights.

instructions_to_main_agent: This project uses Javascript (.js files) - implement components using .js and standard React JSX.
Use framer-motion for line-by-line reveal animations, smooth hover effects, card entrance animations, and lightbox transitions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-book-btn', data-testid='whatsapp-booking-submit', data-testid='menu-category-tab-starters').
Include an Admin page at route '/admin' (or accessible via password protection modal) for real-time menu item CRUD editing.
The booking form must build a prefilled WhatsApp link to +91620224214 with name, date, time, guests, and table preference.
Do NOT use pure transparent header - use blur glassmorphism background (#18110D with 80% opacity + backdrop-blur-xl).
